parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language type. The description of the system access policy is returned in the specified language. Valid values:

- en: English.
- zh-CN: Chinese.
- ja: Japanese.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
Policy Name of the access policy.

Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The type of the access policy. Valid values:

- Custom: custom policy.
- System: system policy.
